verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Sprinto helps customers manage GDPR/compliance frameworks for their own organizations, but contains no documentation of Sprinto itself offering data retention policies, configurable deletion schedules, or user-initiated data purge/export controls for data held within the Sprinto platform. Community evidence even raises concerns about broad internal employee access to customer data, but this doesn't substitute for a documented retention/deletion control feature. Missing for 10: documented retention period settings, data deletion/export APIs or UI, and any policy on how long Sprinto retains customer/evidence data or how a customer can purge it.
